text:
dina: quick design question  we're finalizing the first-run surface. two contenders: thin inline ribbon above the dashboard OR a mini modal "spotlight" that points at a sample project card. pros/cons?

mike: ribbon = low-friction, doesn't steal focus. spotlight = high visibility but risks feeling modal-y.

sam: research note: in remote guerrilla tests, spotlight drove more clicks but also more "where did my cursor go" complaints. ribbon had fewer accidental dismissals.

eva: accessibility angle: ribbon is easier to keep in DOM flow; spotlight needs careful focus management and aria-hidden toggles. both need aria-live for announcements.

dina: copy options for CTA? short/clear preferred.

mike: suggestions: "Launch demo", "Try sample project", "Open demo workspace". vote for "Try sample project" for clarity.

lee: implementation constraints: spotlight requires portal layering + focus trap toggles. ribbon just a new component above the grid. timeline: ribbon ~1 sprint, spotlight ~1.5.

sam: analytics: we should capture impression, cta_click (project_slug), dismiss. also track downstream conversion (workspace_created).

eva: a11y nit: dismiss button visible text "Not now" is ambiguous for SR. add aria-label like "Dismiss onboarding ribbon" and SR-only context "This will not show again". Also ensure visible focus ring and 3:1 contrast at minimum for any small text.

dina: proposal: ship ribbon as default; build spotlight behind flag for A/B test (spotlight vs ribbon). ribbon must be responsive: full-width banner on desktop, stacked single card on mobile. both must include keyboard-accessible CTAs and aria-live polite.

mike: agree. dev flags: onboarding_ui_variant= ribbon|spotlight, onboarding_experiment_pct=10. add kill-switch.

lee: quick CSS note: ribbon height 56px desktop, 80px mobile stacked. use prefers-reduced-motion to disable spotlight animation. thumbnails get alt="Sample: {name} - {one-line}".

sam: event names: onboarding.banner_impression, onboarding.banner_cta_click, onboarding.banner_dismiss. put project_slug in properties.

eva: QA checklist for ticket: tab order, focus management, SR announcement, high-zoom (200%), low-contrast mode, dismiss persistence via localStorage.

dina: i'll update the ticket ONB-2401 with figma frames + copy. want quick dev review tomorrow.

onboard-bot: new ticket ONB-2401 created by dina.

mike: i'll scope engineering tasks and add rough estimates. thanks folks :sparkles:
